name: %system.SYSTEM%
description: System the application under test belongs to.

name: %system.APPLI%
description: Application under test.

name: %system.APP_HOST%
description: Host configured for this application on the country and environment being run.
availability: Resolved from the country/environment parameters of the application. Empty when that combination is not configured — the same misconfiguration that makes a run queue nothing.

name: %system.APP_CONTEXTROOT%
description: Context root configured for this application on the country and environment being run.

name: %system.APP_DOMAIN%
description: First domain configured for the application, before any comma.

name: %system.APP_VAR1%
description: Free variable 1 of the application's country/environment parameters.

name: %system.APP_VAR2%
description: Free variable 2 of the application's country/environment parameters.

name: %system.APP_VAR3%
description: Free variable 3 of the application's country/environment parameters.

name: %system.APP_VAR4%
description: Free variable 4 of the application's country/environment parameters.

name: %system.APP_SECRET1%
description: Secret 1 of the application's country/environment parameters. Masked in execution records.
availability: Resolved like the other application variables, but never echoed back: prefer it to writing a credential into a testcase.

name: %system.APP_SECRET2%
description: Secret 2 of the application's country/environment parameters. Masked in execution records.

name: %system.ENV%
description: Environment the data is taken from, which is the run environment unless overridden.

name: %system.ENVGP%
description: Group of the environment, from the ENVIRONMENT invariant.

name: %system.COUNTRY%
description: Country the testcase is running for.

name: %system.COUNTRYGP1%
description: Group 1 of the country, from the COUNTRY invariant. Groups let a testcase branch on a set of countries without listing them.

name: %system.COUNTRYGP2%
description: Group 2 of the country.

name: %system.COUNTRYGP3%
description: Group 3 of the country.

name: %system.COUNTRYGP4%
description: Group 4 of the country.

name: %system.COUNTRYGP5%
description: Group 5 of the country.

name: %system.COUNTRYGP6%
description: Group 6 of the country.

name: %system.COUNTRYGP7%
description: Group 7 of the country.

name: %system.COUNTRYGP8%
description: Group 8 of the country.

name: %system.COUNTRYGP9%
description: Group 9 of the country.

name: %system.ROBOT%
description: Robot the execution runs on.
availability: Only when the execution is driven by a robot. Empty for SRV, BAT and NONE applications.

name: %system.ROBOTDECLI%
description: Robot declination, which falls back to the robot name when none is set.
availability: Only when the execution is driven by a robot. Empty for SRV, BAT and NONE applications.

name: %system.ROBOTHOST%
description: Host of the robot executor actually selected for this run.
availability: Only when the execution is driven by a robot. Empty for SRV, BAT and NONE applications.

name: %system.BROWSER%
description: Browser used.
availability: Only when the execution is driven by a robot. Empty for SRV, BAT and NONE applications.

name: %system.SCREENSIZE%
description: Screen size used.
availability: Only when the execution is driven by a robot. Empty for SRV, BAT and NONE applications.

name: %system.ROBOTSESSIONID%
description: Session id of the robot, useful to correlate with the robot's own logs.
availability: Only once the robot session is open.

name: %system.ROBOTPROVIDERSESSIONID%
description: Session id on the robot provider side, for a cloud provider.
availability: Only when a robot provider is used, once its session is open.

name: %system.SSIP%
description: Selenium server host.
availability: Only when the execution is driven by a robot. Empty for SRV, BAT and NONE applications.

name: %system.SSPORT%
description: Selenium server port.
availability: Only when the execution is driven by a robot. Empty for SRV, BAT and NONE applications.

name: %system.TEST%
description: Test folder of the running testcase.

name: %system.TESTCASE%
description: Identifier of the running testcase.

name: %system.TESTCASEDESCRIPTION%
description: Description of the running testcase.

name: %system.EXECUTIONID%
description: Numeric id of the running execution, the same one cerberus_testcase_execution_get takes.

name: %system.EXEURL%
description: URL the execution started on.

name: %system.TAG%
description: Tag the execution was queued under.

name: %system.EXESTART%
description: Timestamp the execution started at.

name: %system.EXEELAPSEDMS%
description: Milliseconds elapsed since the execution started.
availability: Recomputed at every substitution, so two uses in the same step yield different values. Use it to measure, never as a stable identifier.

name: %system.EXESTORAGEURL%
description: URL of the folder where this execution's recorded files are stored.

name: %system.CURRENTSTEP_SORT%
description: Sort of the step being executed.
availability: Only inside a step, once at least one step has started.

name: %system.CURRENTSTEP_INDEX%
description: Index of the step being executed, which differs from the sort when the step loops.
availability: Only inside a step, once at least one step has started.

name: %system.CURRENTSTEP_STARTISO%
description: Timestamp the current step started at.
availability: Only inside a step, once at least one step has started.

name: %system.CURRENTSTEP_ELAPSEDMS%
description: Milliseconds elapsed since the current step started.
availability: Only inside a step, once at least one step has started. Recomputed at every substitution.

name: %system.STEP.<sort>.<index>.RETURNCODE%
description: Return code of an already executed step, addressed by its sort and index — for example %system.STEP.10.1.RETURNCODE%. Use it to branch on what an earlier step did.
availability: Only for a step that has already run in this execution. A step that has not run yet leaves the variable untouched, so the literal text reaches the action.

name: %system.LASTSERVICE_RESPONSE%
description: Body of the last service response, the usual way to control a service answer from a GUI, APK or IPA testcase.
availability: Only after the testcase has called a service. Before that the engine substitutes <null>.

name: %system.LASTSERVICE_HTTPCODE%
description: HTTP status code of the last service call.
availability: Only after the testcase has called a service. Before that the engine substitutes <null>.

name: %system.LASTSERVICE_RESPONSETIME%
description: Duration of the last service call, in milliseconds.
availability: Only after the testcase has called a service. Before that the engine substitutes <null>.

name: %system.LASTSERVICE_CALL%
description: Full last service call serialised as JSON: request, response, headers.
availability: Only after the testcase has called a service. Before that the engine substitutes <null>.

name: %system.REMOTEPROXYUUID%
description: Identifier of the recording proxy for this execution.
availability: Only when the executor records network traffic through its proxy.

name: %system.REMOTEPROXY_HAR_URL%
description: URL of the HAR file captured by the recording proxy.
availability: Only when the executor records network traffic through its proxy.

name: %system.TODAY-<format>%
description: Today's date rendered with a Java date pattern: %system.TODAY-yyyy%, %system.TODAY-MM%, %system.TODAY-dd%, %system.TODAY-yyyy.MM.dd%.

name: %system.TOMORROW-<format>%
description: Tomorrow's date, same formats as TODAY.

name: %system.YESTERDAY-<format>%
description: Yesterday's date, same formats as TODAY.

name: %system.<UNIT><+|-><n>-<format>%
description: Date shifted by an offset, for example %system.DAY+3-dd% or %system.MONTH-1-yyyy.MM%. UNIT is YEAR, MONTH, WEEK, DAY, HOUR or MINUTE.
